resources.string: The app needs the Nearby devices permission to find and connect to your rolling door.
On Android 11 and below, scanning for Bluetooth devices needs the location permission. It is only used while pairing; the app never reads where you are.
The permission was turned down. Open the app settings and allow it there.
Turn on Bluetooth to connect to your rolling door.
On Android 11 and below, location must be on to find the device while pairing.
Scan the QR code printed by the device so this phone can control the door. The first phone to pair becomes the admin.
Paste the setup code, starting with RDOOR1:
This is not a valid setup code
The device is not advertising open pairing. If another phone is already paired, hold the BOOT button for 3 seconds.
Scan the QR code printed by the device. Its text starts with RDOOR1.
Allow the camera to scan the QR code, or enter the code manually below.
The camera is busy or unavailable. Enter the code manually below.
Turn on Bluetooth and try again.
Allow nearby devices for this app and try again.
Stand close to the door, check that the device has power, and try again.
The connection dropped while pairing. Move closer to the device and try again.
Hold the BOOT button on the device for 3 seconds, then try again.
Wrong QR code for this device
This code belongs to another device. Scan the code printed by this device.
Too many failed attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
Remove a paired phone before adding a new one.
The device answered something unexpected. Try again; if it keeps failing, check the firmware.
Point the camera at the QR code
This QR code is not for a rolling door
Connects by itself when you are near the door.
Check that the device has power, then try again.
The device firmware does not match this app.
Pairing is open for 60 seconds. Scan the device’s QR code on the new phone.
The door did not answer. Check the door before pressing again.
The device no longer accepts this phone. Forget the device in Settings and pair again.
Too many failed attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
The device could not send the signal to the door.
Only the admin phone can do this.
Opens pairing for 60 seconds. Within that time, scan this device’s QR code on the new phone. Needs a connection to the door.
This phone will no longer control the door until it pairs again with the device’s QR code. The device keeps this phone’s key slot until an admin removes it or the device is reset.
